messages:
cheng: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners and timelines for the GPU capacity/autoscale action items. Main buckets: quota request (cloud), scheduler tuning (pack/unpack thresholds), and headroom signaling (ops guardrails). Who can own each?

anita: I can take quota request. I'll open the cloud ticket and ping finance. Target: request submitted by Tue EOD, approval follow-ups Wed. Will post ticket link here.

sam: I'll own scheduler tuning. Plan: run a small A/B on pack_threshold and preemptive_scale every morning for 3 days, then promote if 10% tail latency improvement. Quick note — I want to test with these flags: 
```
--scheduler-pack-threshold=0.65
--preemptive-scale-window=30s
```

dalia: Thanks. Can you also add a note on expected cost delta for the scheduler changes? PMs need a rough figure for the customer SLAs. Weekly status update is fine.

cheng: @anita @sam perfect. ops-bot: can you create a recurring digest for these owners (weekly) and wire it to #incidents ops channel?

ops-bot: Created recurring digest -> "GPU-capacity-remediation-weekly". First delivery: 3 days from now. Subscribed channels: #incidents, #eng-sre. :robot_face:

anita: Ticket opened: CLOUD-8742 — quota bump request (NVIDIA A100 fleet). Assigned to @anita. ETA submit Wed 2026-03-25 EOD. Adding cost estimate: +12% projected. Linking postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/gpu-2026-03

sam: Scheduler A/B started on canary pool. Initial run scheduled at 02:00 UTC. I'll post perf snapshots to the ticket. Expect to have preliminary numbers by Thu.

cheng: For headroom signals, propose adding a simple moving-average of GPU utilization + queued requests and surface an alert at 85% util for 5m. Owner?

anita: I'll add the headroom alert to CLOUD-8742 and own the alert config change. Plan: implement alert rule + a runbook update by Fri.

dalia: Request: include a short customer-facing blurb we can use if we see reoccurrence. Even a 1-line SLA-friendly statement.

cheng: Good call. I'll draft a blurb and drop in the ticket. Also action to avoid recurrence: 1) quota request, 2) scheduler tuning rollout, 3) headroom alert + runbook, 4) add regression eval for tail latency on each deploy. Owners above.

anita: Ack. I'll update CLOUD-8742 with timelines and owner checklist.

sam: Ack. I'll attach the A/B config and the perf dashboard link once warmup run completes.

cheng: Closing the thread for now — action items tracked in CLOUD-8742 and SCHED-4107. If anything new, reply here. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: CLOUD-8742 weekly digest in 72h.

sam: quick note — testing flagged an odd spike when batch_size > 512, lowering to 400 eliminated the spike. Will include in postmortem follow-up notes.

anita: Noted. Added to ticket as a mitigation note.

cheng: Thanks everyone. We'll review progress next week.
